title: KDI Explorer
blurb: Moldable alternative to kdi tui; drill down from source to grounding, and out through the entity graph
note: McKdiEvidence defines McKdiObject, which every other class subclasses, so reloading it alone leaves the rest stale. Always file these in as a set. McKdiGraph is last because McKdiSlice's contributions build McKdiGraphArc; the reference is resolved at run time, so the order only has to put McKdiObject first. The suites live in pharo/McKdiGraphTest.st and run against a fake binding, so nothing here needs a live kdi.
